[Deep-learning translation Japanese→English]

I spend most of my VRChat time playing MMD.

In MMD, I have a hundred times more fun than others.

My avatar is a bit like an old fashioned avatar.

When I dance in MMD, I find that I have a little more control over my avatar.

I can control the opening of my avatar's eyes and left hand.

This is a lot of fun.

My avatar can dance very lively.

In iY MMD World, my avatar's hands do not move when dancing, so I contacted the author of that world.

He said that the correct specification of the hands not moving is the specification of VRChat and the author of that world has no control over it.

I am very afraid that VRChat will be updated and my avatar's hand will not move.

I would like to be able to move my hands in the VRChat MMD world specs.

I would like to see a culture grow up where people dance with a little control over their avatars instead of just watching them move automatically.

I want VRchat to create such a specification.

(controllable MMD? → CMMD)

I hope VRChat will be a more enjoyable world.

My MMD dance
